accepted.evidence: DEDR 474 explicitly gives Malto iwr “two persons”, exactly the LSI form ivr. The LSI questionnaire gloss “Two Fathers” is contextual; the response itself supplies only the personal numeral, so no father component is inferred.

DEDR 4616 is a whole child/offspring article: it gives Malto maqo “young, small” and maqi “girl”, and Tamil makaḷ “daughter”. LSI maqoθ “daughter” has the maqo stem with nominal -θ; the article-level link does not claim DEDR directly glosses Malto maqo as daughter.
